sources.snippet: srlwam: Cosmos Edge stack_v2 sim policy, stride 4 A Cosmos3 Edge policy for Franka two-cube stacking, fine-tuned from nvidia/Cosmos3-Edge-Policy-DROID on the stack_v2 simulation demos with a temporal stride of 4: each model step covers 4 recorded 10 Hz steps. It is the stride-4 variant of the sim_v2_droid checkpoints in aabyaneh/srlwam, built from Amin's srlwam cosmos_stack_v2_stride3 code ...
